novice.0: Use shortcut keys to easily open menus.
novice.1: Find and use hidden portals in the map.
novice.2: Use portals to move to other areas.
novice.3: Portals to other areas are displayed in the Minimap as blue circles.
novice.4: All player characters will be shown as red dots on the Minimap.
novice.6: You can buy equipment and potions for your adventure from NPC shops in the game.
novice.7: You can distribute the AP you earn when you gain a level in the Stats window.
novice.8: You cannot switch to different job after your 1st Job Advancement.
novice.9: Double-click an equipment item in your Inventory window, or drag it into the Equip window to equip it.

novice2.0: There is a shop in every town where you can purchase equipment and potions.
novice2.1: Some items can only be used by a certain gender or class. Double-check before you buy!
novice2.2: Be careful! Death will cause you to lose some EXP after you take your job advancement.
novice2.3: Completing quests will earn you items you can't find in shops.

novice3.0: Passive Skills begin working automatically as soon as you learn them.
novice3.1: To use Active skills faster, drag the icon from the Skill window into one of your quickslots.
novice3.3: Distribute Skill Points in the Skills window.
novice3.4: Be careful! Powerful monsters dwell in the underground dungeons.
novice3.5: Defeating more powerful monsters will earn you treasures not found in any shop.
novice3.6: MP recovers little by little after a set amount of time has passed.
novice3.7: Skills that cost MP cannot be used without MP.
novice3.8: Return Scrolls will get you back to town and back into action much faster than walking.
novice3.9: If you run out of Throwing Stars, they will not disappear from your inventory.

novice4.0: Use a variety of skills to beef up your weapons and armor!
novice4.1: Some quests and items have a Fame requirement.
novice4.2: There are some quests that can be completed multiple times.
